graphics: 1920x1080 Epic, screen percentage100%, VSync off, dynamic resolution off, fixed camera, offscreen rendering
bc_order: Alternating B then C per round and client count
selection_rule: C GPU mean median improves at least 3% for single-client and both dual-client roles; P95 regression at most 3% in every group. Otherwise retain B.
primary_gpu_window: CSV GPUTime mean in the common 30s QPC window, then median of three runs
baseline_note: This fresh A differs from the prior session baseline; do not combine improvement percentages across sessions.
